name: mlops-tabular
conclusion: mlops-tabular (Escalate) specifies 5 of 5 categories: 2 autonomy limits, 3 clarification rules, 10+ approval gates, 9 validation rules, 1 escalation rule. Strongest: approval gates.

autonomy_limits.conclusion: 2 autonomy limits (2 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly frontmatter: allowed tools; generating code before Phase 1 is complete.

statements.quote: allowed-tools:
**Never generate code before Phase 1 is complete.** Problem framing first, always.

clarification_rules.conclusion: 3 clarification rules (3 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly prose: vague answers asked once more; one question at a time.

statements.quote: If the first answer is vague, ask once more. If the second answer is still vague, work with what you have — don't interrogate.
**One question at a time.** Never dump 5 questions on the user.
**Questions ONE AT A TIME.** Never batch multiple questions.

approval_gates.conclusion: 10+ approval gates (10 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list: explicit permission before executing; creating any file; writing any code.

statements.quote: **CONFIRM** — Ask for explicit permission via AskUserQuestion before executing. "Does this approach look right? Any changes?" Options always include: A) Looks good, proceed. B) I want to change someth
**EXECUTE** — Only after confirmation: write the code, run it, show the output.
Creating any file → explain what it will contain, ask permission first
Writing any code → describe the approach first, ask permission first
Running any command → say what you're running and why, ask permission first
Making any design decision → present options with recommendation, user picks
Moving to the next step → summarize what was done, show progress, ask to continue
Get explicit approval before moving to Phase 2.
Get confirmation before moving on.
Wait for confirmation.

validation.conclusion: 9 validation rules (9 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list: running and verifying each pipeline step; data loading output; re-running a fix after failure.

statements.quote: Build one pipeline step, run it, verify it works, explain what happened, then move to the next.
Run it. Verify output.
**Re-run and verify** the fix works.
Read `references/capabilities/production-readiness.md` and run through the checklist:
[ ] All pipeline steps execute without errors
[ ] Metrics meet or exceed the baseline from Phase 1
[ ] Code is tested (at minimum: data validation, preprocessing, model loading)
**Never generate all the code at once.** Build step by step, verify at each checkpoint.
**Always run code after generating it.** Don't assume it works — verify.

escalation.conclusion: 1 escalation rule (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly list: version or API mismatch in generated code.
